bills.title: Future Made in Australia (Omnibus Amendments No. 1) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-09-09.140.1) introduced by Treasurer and Rankin MP [Jim Chalmers](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/rankin/jim_chalmers) (Labor), which means it will now form part of the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 2, item 43, page 18 (after line 15), after section 61, insert:* > >> *62 Long service leave* >> >> *ARENA [Australian Renewable Energy Agency] is a public authority of the Commonwealth for the purposes of the Long Service Leave (Commonwealth Employees) Act 1976.*
question: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-09-09.140.1) introduced by Treasurer and Rankin MP [Jim Chalmers](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/rankin/jim_chalmers) (Labor), which means it will now form part of the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 2, item 43, page 18 (after line 15), after section 61, insert:* > >> *62 Long service leave* >> >> *ARENA [Australian Renewable Energy Agency] is a public authority of the Commonwealth for the purposes of the Long Service Leave (Commonwealth Employees) Act 1976.*
